notes: Two cameras: ONLY the main camera (Camera 1) starts and stops recording now. Camera 2 never starts or stops — its hand signs used to cancel Camera 1’s hold, because the other hand hanging at your side reads as a different sign and reset the hold before it could fire. Hold 1 finger up to Camera 1 to start, 2 fingers to stop. The Camera 2 screen says the main camera controls recording. The rig is no longer throttled in two-camera mode: the old step-down cut each camera to about 2 fresh poses per second on slower phones, which read as a laggy rig. Inference now runs at full rate on both cameras, and “smooth mode” is gone — a rig that draws just says it’s on. Voice now speaks on iPhone: turning Voice coaching on says “Voice coaching on” out loud, which proves voice works and unlocks the phone’s speech audio. The old code cancelled speech right before speaking, which iOS silently swallowed, so the start/stop announcements never sounded. The “Waiting for Camera 2…” line now disappears the moment Camera 2 connects, instead of sitting there under a live Camera 2 feed.
